The packaging on this product has had an update. You may receive this product in either the packaging shown or the old packaging. There is no changes to the specification.

A hardwearing, protective satin finish. Based on polyurethane alkyd resins which have been designed to withstand spillage and repeated cleaning. Ideal for use on most concrete and wooden floors in garages, warehouses, workshops and factories. 16-24 hour re-coat time. Fully cured in 7 days.
